scene_description: Wooden table with an open brown box on a closed silver laptop at the left. A brown Data Structures book projects beyond the front edge on the right. Front is the open table edge; left and right are as seen facing it.

targets.name: silver laptop
targets.description: Closed silver Apple laptop on the left, with the brown box resting on the rear-right part of its lid.
nearby_obstacles: Brown box resting on its lid
targets.clearance_notes: Front and left edges are exposed, but the box rests on the rear-right part of the lid.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the brown box off the laptop and place it on the open table.

targets.name: brown box
targets.description: Open brown cardboard box holding small loose items, resting on the rear-right part of the silver laptop.
targets.clearance_notes: Sides are exposed beneath the open flaps, with no overhead obstruction.
targets.other_notes: Dimensions describe the box body, excluding the unfolded flaps.

targets.name: brown Data Structures book
targets.description: Brown Schaum's 'Data Structures' paperback lying to the right of the laptop, with its front portion overhanging the table edge.
targets.clearance_notes: Top and sides are exposed, but the front portion extends beyond the supporting surface.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the book toward the center of the table until its whole cover is supported.

targets.other_notes: Front portion overhangs the table edge.
